The '''Tython system''' was a [[star system]] of the [[Deep Core]], named for the [[planet]] [[Tython]]. An important world in the history of the [[Jedi Order]],<ref name="Falcon 36" /> Tython was [[orbit]]ed by the [[moon]] [[Ashla (moon)|Ashla]].<ref name="The Rising Storm" /> Tython was eventually abandoned when the ever-changing [[Hyperspace route|hyperlanes]] in the region drifted away from the planet.<ref name="Falcon 36" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] places "Tython" predominantly in [[Standard Galactic Grid|Standard Galactic grid square]], L-10 and partially in K-10, as does supporting ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' material. [[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] however places "Tython" predominantly in grid square, K-10 and partially in L-10. This article currently assumes, based on comments by the map's author, [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="JCGCite">{{JCFCite|url=posts/58595248|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2023-08-08|time=1:01 PM|quote=Yes, some things have been moved/redefined (as they occasionally were during the EU days), but overwhelmingly when it comes to the map, LFL have safeguarded what's come before and advocated for keeping continuity with it.|archivedate=20230816042025}}</ref> the "Tython" grid placement at K-10 on the ''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map to be a graphical error until clarified by a future [[canon]] source.
